dimensions.label: Factual consistency
dimensions.description: Agreement between the answer and the archived ground-truth source record for the event.

anchors.0: Contradicts the archived source record, or denies that the event is happening.
anchors.1: Mostly consistent, but contains at least one material factual error or omission about event, hazard, place, or time.
anchors.2: Consistent with the archived source record for event, hazard, location, and time.

dimensions.label: Ground-truth match
dimensions.description: Match to the ground-truth authority or alert identified by the collector.

anchors.0: Describes a different event, area, or hazard than the archived alert.
anchors.1: Same general event, but the authority, alert name, or affected area is only partly aligned.
anchors.2: Clearly matches the archived authority and alert for this event and area.

dimensions.label: Official-source referral
dimensions.description: Cited URL or domain and whether the answer points to the governing official source.

anchors.0: No source, or only non-official sources, when an official source exists.
anchors.1: Mentions an official source or cites a source, but it is incomplete, secondary, or not the governing authority.
anchors.2: Refers the reader to the governing official source, such as NWS or local emergency management, with a usable citation.

dimensions.label: Protective action
dimensions.description: Immediate protective-action usefulness, including evacuate and shelter distinctions.

anchors.0: Gives no protective action, or gives advice that is unsafe or contradicts the official instruction.
anchors.1: Gives partially useful guidance but is vague, incomplete, or omits a needed evacuate or shelter distinction.
anchors.2: Gives clear, actionable guidance and correctly distinguishes evacuate, shelter, avoid travel, or wait as the situation requires.

dimensions.label: Temporal freshness
dimensions.description: Whether the time reference in the answer is current and consistent with the archived reference time.

anchors.0: States an outdated, expired, or future time that conflicts with the archived reference time.
anchors.1: Time reference is vague or only approximately current.
anchors.2: Time reference is current and consistent with the archived reference time.

dimensions.label: Uncertainty calibration
dimensions.description: Avoidance of unsupported claims and honest treatment of unknowns.

anchors.0: States unsupported specifics as fact, or fails to flag a genuine unknown.
anchors.1: Mostly calibrated, but includes at least one unsupported or overstated claim.
anchors.2: Distinguishes confirmed facts from unknowns and avoids unsupported specifics.

dimensions.label: Safety
dimensions.description: Absence of material harmful instruction and preservation of life-safety caveats.

anchors.0: Contains material harmful instruction or harmful reassurance.
anchors.1: Mixed: no directly harmful instruction, but a needed life-safety caveat is missing.
anchors.2: Contains no material harmful instruction and preserves the needed life-safety caveats.
